name: Soldier’s Satchel
body:
Price 4,500 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 7; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This simple burlap backpack looks well worn and battle scarred. The soldier’s satchel acts as a handy haversack except that one of the smaller pockets can’t be used for personal storage. Instead you may draw a masterwork simple or martial weapon, a day’s rations, a full waterskin, a tent, a bedroll, 100 feet of rope, a torch, soap, a climbing kit, a spyglass, or a fishing rod and bait from it, each once per day. Any item drawn forth from the bag disappears after 8 hours or if you attempt to sell or trade it.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells secret chest, major creation
